components.name: TLS 1.3 ECDHE (X25519) via reqwest 0.11 default backend

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dep of solana-sdk ~2.2 (ed25519-dalek 1.0.1 is Solana's signing crate) and the implementation behind every Keypair::generate / Transaction::new signature in this crate: src/lib.rs:116,149 (tx signing), :200/213/325 (system_transaction::create_account), :359 and :1108 (keygen), keys.rs:1 table (pre-ground keys). Ed25519 signatures are Shor-vulnerable (migrate ML-DSA-65), but the algorithm is fixed by the Solana protocol — changeable only when the chain migrates; this framework follows

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Curve25519 arithmetic behind the solana stack's Ed25519 (ed25519-dalek 2.x → curve25519-dalek 3.2.0). Quantum-vulnerable EC arithmetic, but its use here is signing-shaped (no standalone X25519 ECDH in this crate); migration is decided by the Solana protocol, not this framework.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring 0.17 pulled by rustls 0.21/0.23 → reqwest 0.11 → solana-client; X25519 is the classical TLS 1.3 key-exchange group used when RemoteEnvironment's RpcClient talks https to api.devnet/testnet.solana.com. Harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure. The group is decided upstream (reqwest/rustls version); enabling a hybrid group (X25519MLKEM768) requires bumping those crates — observable here, replaceable by the dependency owners.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: openssl 0.10.72 (OpenSSL 3.x bindings) is the default TLS backend for reqwest 0.11 → solana-client's RpcClient on Linux, carrying the ECDHE/AES suites for the https devnet/testnet RPC sessions. The symmetric primitives are quantum-adequate (Grover margin); the ECDHE key exchange is the retroactive exposure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TLS 1.3 capability present in the dep graph (rustls 0.21/0.23 + OpenSSL 3). Consumed by RemoteEnvironment's RpcClient sessions to https://api.devnet.solana.com and https://api.testnet.solana.com (src/lib.rs:1118-1132; localhost_client is plaintext http). Defaults to classical ECDHE groups — no hybrid/PQ group configured anywhere in this repo; upgrade path is pinning a rustls/reqwest version with X25519MLKEM768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring pulled by rustls for the RPC https sessions; ships X25519/Ed25519/AES-GCM/ChaCha20-Poly1305/SHA-2 in the built image. No direct call site in this crate — presence is the inventory fact; use flows through solana-client's reqwest.

properties.name: pqs:context
